cells.gaps: The 1,541 commune databases are a 2019 count given with no total of local offices (communes and their administrative annexes), and the newest offices fact (DZA-012, 2025) gives no count or share entering digitally and finds paper persisting. The facts valued connected (DZA-002, DZA-008) do not say the entry is made at the commune office when the event is registered; the law keeps paper registers and sends a digitised copy. Nothing is held for the last twelve months and no rural figure is given.
cells.note: Births are registered in the national automated register across the communes, with the NIN issued at registration since 2018, so the system is past its pilot and live. Stage 4 needs words placing the entry at the office and more than half of offices on a share or a count with a denominator; the evidence gives a count alone.
